characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Shiroha is the main heroine of Summer Pockets. She is a calm and shy girl who doesn’t have any friends. While she is anxious around strangers, she is also well-composed. Other than her blood-related grandfather, she has nobody who can even be called a friend. She was a loner for a bit too long, so she’s somewhat socially awkward. She frequently gazes over the sea on the isolated island.

Kamome is a mysterious girl who is seen from time to time on the island, and is always dragging a big suitcase along with her. She uses the suitcase in many clever ways and when it gets annoying, she just rides on top of it. It seems that, like Hairi, she came to the island for just this summer. She has a bad habit of meddling with things out of pure curiosity and getting herself in danger, so it's sort of hard to leave her on her own. It looks like she came to the island to search for something. In her hands is an old map… "This is a treasure map!"

Ao is a girl who doesn't care about genders and talks to everyone like they're her friend, and has a tendency to purposefully ignore everything love-related. Ao acts like one of the core members of a local boy-scouts-like group; promptly taking command of any situation. She may not seem like it, but she is a covert pervert. Ao frequently mishears words and misinterprets them in a erotic way, only to become bashful herself. She works part-time at the island's candy shop, and the local kids call her "Sensei''. If she has the time, she can sleep anywhere.

Tsumugi is a calm and honest half-German girl who decided to use this summer vacation to, "look for things she wants to do". Her personal philosophy is, "Classic books and rules were polished over time to be as rational as possible". Because of that, she even follows rules that clearly don't fit modern society. She is a bit lenient though, and doesn't try to force others to follow those rules. For someone who always talks about rules and logic, whenever she loses a debate, she moans with a mortifying "Mugyu~". Even though she is a calm and collected girl and it feels like she can do anything, sometimes she just blankly stares somewhere or starts talking in monotone. And then there are times when her clothes are frayed like she just rampaged through the mountains. She unexpectedly has a lot of weak points.

Umi is the second cousin of Hairi Takahara who has lived her whole life in the city, but she always admired life in the countryside and it’s the reason why she has come to Torishirojima for the summer. During the summer, she often cooks for Hairi. Her specialty is fried rice; she's extremely passionate about fried rice. ~!She is the daughter of Hairi and Shiroha in the future.!~

Hairi is a young man who is not a native to Torishirojima, as he grew up in a more urban area. He used to be a dedicated swimmer at his high school in the city, but after a certain incident he is now afraid of going into the water. Due to said incident, he uses the recent death of his grandmother as an excuse to come to the island for the summer to take care of her estate sale.

title: 女儿离家后成为S级冒险者

characters.description: An S-Rank adventurer renowned as the Black-Haired Valkyrie. Abandoned in the forest as a baby, she was picked up and raised as Belgrieve's daughter. She loves her father.

A former adventurer whose dreams were shattered long ago. An injury forced him to return to his hometown, but part of him could never give up on adventuring. This inspired his daughter to follow his path, and even now, he continues to train. He is quite bothered by the moniker 'Red Ogre" his daughter gave him.
A member of Angeline's party who specializes in magic. She and Anessa hail from the same orphanage. An AAA-Rank adventurer.
The mediator, negotiator, and archer of Angeline's party. She and Miriam hail from the same orphanage. An AAA-Rank adventurer.

characters.native: ヘルベチカ・ボルドー
characters.description: Countess of the Bordeaux region, and the eldest of the sisters. Though gifted in her own right, she tends to lose herself when talented people are around.

title: 单人房、日照一般、附天使。

characters.description: An angel who came from heaven to study humans. She moves into [Shintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/316296/) apartment and they start living together. She has a kind and humble personality, but is ignorant of the circumstances of the human world. When she gets excited, her angel wings accidentally pop out.

He started living on his own when he entered high school due to his parents' work commitments. He is a caring and kind person who is considerate towards everyone and notices the good in others. He's a perfectly normal high school student, but he's the type you can rely on in an emergency.

[Shintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/316296/) classmate who works at the same family restaurant. When she closed her heart in order to hide her identity, she was rumored to be the "Ice Queen" due to her cool appearance. ~!She is actually a yuki onna and when she gets emotional, she causes a blizzard.!~

[Shintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/316296/) classmate who works at a maid cafe. She is a full-on vampire who wears an eyepatch, bandage, and colored contact lenses. She likes Shintarou's "scent" and tries to "hook up" him whenever she gets a chance. Her real name is Sayuri Kagami. She belongs to the occult research club.

[Shintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/316296/) classmate. She fell in love with him when they were both children and they had a fateful reunion in high school. Even now, she continues to hold an unrequited love for him, but every day she feels daunted by the unique girls around him. She is good at studying and cooking.

__Talent:__ A talent enabling the wielding of swordsmanship reaching beyond human limits. Two blades—the “Kubi-gari” and the “Hara sogi”—materialize, awakening superhuman strength and dynamic visual acuity. She is [Touya's](https://anilist.co/character/214623/Touya-Senji) classmate, but doesn't attend school often. She was invited to join the Kendo club as a scholarship student, and is a master swordsman feared by those around her. She has a bright and combative personality, and sometimes enjoys fighting.

__Talent:__ A talent for quantifying all information and predicting the future. This awakens incredible calculation and thinking abilities, resulting in accuracy so high that it is said to be able to predict the future. A girl who always sits in a wheelchair. She is the leader of the Forest of Great Men, a group of people who aim for "world peace," and one of its original members. In contrast to her young appearance, she is always calm, collected, and rational, and is the sole leader of the chain of command for her companions.

A student at the First High School affiliated with a certain national university. He is an extremely hard worker, studying and training until late at night, and always placing in the top 100 in national mock exams. Having grown up being compared to his genius older brother, he craves "talent" and feels intense jealousy towards "those who possess talent."

characters.native: アルバート アインシュタイン
aliases: A. Einstein (A・アインシュタイン)
characters.description: __Talent:__ The ability to teleport by swapping spaces. However, there is a restriction that teleportation is only possible within the range of coordinates registered by the user. One of the original members of the Forest of Great Men. She is mainly in charge of combat and movement, and is considered one of the "two strongest" along with [Newton](https://anilist.co/character/214621/Newton). She intensely dislikes men, even objecting to other women interacting with them.

Kouu transmigrated from unnamed man. His talent is Omnireceptacle which allows him to control and use everything as a weapon with his battle aura. He was one of founding members of Forest of the Greats.

title: 莱莎的炼金工房 ～常暗女王与秘密藏身处～

characters.native: ライザリン・シュタウト
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm An ordinary girl whose unique characteristic is the fact that she is just that - ordinary. Ryza has a wild and tomboyish personality with a strong sense of justice. While she can be stubborn in her convictions, her heart is in the right place. Her whole world is turned upside down during an extraordinary encounter...

__Height:__ 164 cm As a member of the fallen Oren race in the Underworld, she strives a goal to eliminate the remaining problems left by the extinct Klint Kingdom, and avenge her homeland from the Philscuha's invasion together with [Empel Vollmer](https://anilist.co/character/300893/Vollmer-Empel).

characters.native: クラウディア・バレンツ
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm Klaudia is the daughter of wealthy travelling merchant. She possesses a refined aura and kind personality. She has an interest in music and practices playing the flute, but hides it from her father. When visiting Kurken Island she makes friends with [Ryza](https://anilist.co/character/223350/Stout-Reisalin), [Lent](https://anilist.co/character/300891/Marslink-Lent) and [Tao](https://anilist.co/character/300892/Mongarten-Tao), and becomes one of the members of the secret hideout. Together they share many adventures over the summer.

characters.native: アンペル・フォルマー
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm Empel is a wandering alchemist investigating the ruins of the Klint Kingdom together with Lila Decyrus. Due to an injury, he is unable to perform advanced techniques but teaches Ryza the world of Alchemy as she has the talent. He apparently has a sweet tooth that enjoys all kinds of sweets, of which he would often buy dozens of them

characters.native: レント・マルスリンク
characters.description: __Height:__ 179 cm Lent is a childhood friend of Ryza and Tao, who, together, aims to venture out to the mainland and explore the world out from their homeland. Furthermore, as an aspiring adventurer, he wants to be a known man who travels past the restricted and unknown places of which no one ever been before so that he can be acknowledged for who he can become, and overshadow his now drunk abusive father

__Height:__ 170 cm Tao is childhood friends with Ryza and Lent who, together, aims to venture out to the mainland and explore the world out from their homeland, although he is the most hesitant out of the group to actually join the voyage. His family owns old books that contain ancient language and aims to discover and learn it as they travel.

A part-time worker at Every Mart, he appears to be carefree and casual in both looks and behavior, seemingly irresponsible. However, he has a caring and protective side, akin to an older brother. After a chance encounter with Yoshihiro, he starts to take an interest in him and looks after him. (Source: Official Site)

Hana Ayukawa is a high school student who both lives and works at [Machida](https://anilist.co/character/343190/Machida)'s convenience store. She has a strong passion for fishing, and was the one who saved [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/341776/Tsunehiro-Sasaki) from drowning.

Tsunehiro Sasaki is a depressed university student with a large debt and gambling addiction who was told by his doctor that he only has two years left to live. He ends up meeting a group of fishermen after falling off a bridge into the ocean while he was running away from a group of debt collectors, with one girl named [Hana Ayukawa](https://anilist.co/character/341777/Hana-Ayukawa) rescuing him.

A beginner at fishing, just like Tsunehiro, working part-time at Everymart. Always smiling and approachable, the type who can easily be misunderstood. Social by nature and friendly with everyone, particularly fond of Hana and constantly following her around.

A model, cosplayer, and part-time worker from Thailand who loves anime and manga. She has the vitality to juggle multiple roles and is a natural mood maker. Her positive attitude and straightforward personality earn her a lot of trust from those around her.

A young girl rescued by Dennis from being sold into slavery. She becomes the poster girl for the adventurer's diner Dennis opens. Though she appears quiet and expressionless, she has a kind heart. Her signature pose is a peace sign.

A boisterous soul with a heart of gold, Dennis can't ignore anyone in need. After being exiled from the top-tier adventurer party, “The Silverwing Battalion”, he finally pursues his lifelong dream of opening his own restaurant. Though combat isn't his specialty, he wields the strongest cooking skills imaginable, honed during his time as one of Silverwing's most formidable fighters. He's known as the “Legendary Fried Rice Chef”.

A female swordsman unreasonably exiled from her party for the simple reason of being a woman. The Adventurer’s Restaurant’s first customer. Taking advantage of Dennis's kindness, she eats on credit. Her favorite dish at the restaurant is “Britora Bowls”.

A hardworking sage and a corporate drone. An exceptional young woman who graduated from magic school with honors, bearing the expectations of her hometown. She joins the adventurer party in order to return the money used by her village to send her to school. Her favorite meal at the restaurant is the “Fried Shrimp Set”.

An excessively self-conscious and often cocky handsome young wizard. Believes he’s surrounded by ignorant people and has a hard time fitting in. His signature spell is “Parm”. His favorite dish at the restaurant is “Shrimp Fried Rice”.

title: 忍者与杀手二人组的日常生活

characters.description: A recent runaway from a ninja village who is ignorant about the outside world. She is useless at Ninja battle techniques, but has the special ninjutsu ability to turn objects into leaves. Her experience doing chores for the village makes her skilled at cleaning.

Despite looking like a normal high school girl, she is an assassin. She invites [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) to help with her assassin work due to the usefulness of her ninjutsu. Outside of work she is somewhat of a slob and her real name is unknown.

A rival assassin to [Konoha](https://anilist.co/character/341513/Konoha-Koga) who uses various inventions instead of combat ability. As an apology for kidnapping [Satoko,](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) she sends [Roboko](https://anilist.co/character/350518/Roboko) to Konoha.

Leader of the fugitive ninjas who convinced [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/341512/Satoko-Kusagakure) to leave the village, she regrets dragging Satoko into her personal business and tries to help her when she can. She has ninjutsu which erases memories and currently is unemployed as she lives with her [girlfriend](https://anilist.co/character/350517/Yuriko).

Ordinary person who lives together with [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/350516/Kuro). She is a beautiful woman and a good person, but also readily accepts ninjas and assassins so may also be a weird person.

Mayonaka Punch's leader, who recently woke up from a 20 year supernatural slumber. She feels like she has a fated connection to [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/329072/Masaki-Sonoue) and agrees to collaborate on a channel in order to drink her blood.

Producer of the Mayonaka Punch channel. She is in charge of planning, filming, and editing the videos single-handedly. Her biggest problem is her selfish nature, which caused her falling out with her previous channel "Hyped-up Sisters."
Member of the Mayonaka Punch channel with a shy personality who often acts as the most sensible person in Mayonaka Punch. She has a part time job at a bathhouse and enjoys music.

Member of Mayonaka Punch channel, who lives with the other members inside Banpai Manor, which she has a strong attachment to as a place. She has a childlike demeanor but sees herself as an older sister type.
Member of the Mayonaka Punch channel who loves gambling and money. She is a wild and free person who often causes problems for others.

__Height:__ 160 cm __Cyberkinesis:__ Parasocial Pistol A member of Miden Academy's Level 1 Class B. A "smotherer", she spends her online time cyberstalking a bassist from a band she loves. Much like her love, her cyberkinesis manifests a gun that glues her to her target. She also loves eating sweet potato sticks and can't leave home without them.

__Height:__ 180 cm __Cyberkinesis:__ Banhammer of Civility A member of Miden Academy's Level 1 Class B, and Souji's roommate. A former gang member, he tends to use foul language but immediately course-corrects to act like a proper honors student. A "thumper", he has a daily routine of posting comments online to "correct the evil that overflows on the internet." His cyberkinesis, in turn, manifests as a massive hammer that keeps the peace of internet discourse.

__Height:__ 173 cm __Cyberkinesis:__ Onipien He is one of the most well-known problematic streamers and is best known for his MyTuber username "Aoringo." After the death of his sister, he is enrolled into Miden Academy to find the person responsible for her death. His cyberkenesis, owing to his past as a flamebaiter, calls forth eerie blue flames. Loves sweets, but often eats too much of them.

__Height:__ 175 cm __Cyberkinesis:__ World Through a Shutter A member of Miden Academy's Level 1 Class B, and Kukuru's childhood friend. In spite of his kind expression, he can also be a venomous little devil at times. Loves snappingphotos on his phone, and his cyberkinesis allows him to create "windows" wherever he's taken one.

__Height:__ 146 cm __Cyberkinesis:__ Hardcore Gamer-Powered Doll A member of Miden Academy's Level 1 Class B, an esports player and expert in hand-to-hand combat. She's withdrawn and loath to communicate in person, but her cyberkinesis allows her to control dolls that she can control using her video game skills. Typically uses Denmi-chan, Miden Academy's mascot, in battle.

__Height:__ 183 cm __Cyberkinesis:__ Nirvana Wall A member of Miden Academy's Level 1 Class B. Contrary to his appearance, he doesn't like loud noises and is easily frightened. His cyberkinesis is more defense-oriented, creating walls of sound to protect himself and others when he listens to his MP3 player. Likes music, especially rock, and listens to them with his headphones gifted to him by his teacher.

__Height:__ 188 cm Teacher of Miden Academy's Level 1 Class B. Once called the genius youth of exorcists, he now works to teach the next generation of them. Digitally inept, he can only fight dead accounts by converting his spiritual energy to digital using a special fan - while incredibly powerful, it's only a fraction of his power in its prime. Zero immunity to women.

title: 东岛丹三郎想成为假面骑士

characters.description: A high school teacher who aspires to become the next Electronic Wave Humanoid Tackle. She encountered Kamen Rider Stronger as a child and became a passionate fan of the Electronic Wave Humanoid Tackle. After Tackle's death, she resolved to become Tackle herself, and while she was training every day in preparation for the Shocker attack, she witnessed the news of the Shocker attack. She is usually cool, but when it comes to talking about Tackle, she can get too excited.

A 40-year-old man who dreams of becoming a Kamen Rider. He earns money from part-time jobs and trains in the mountains, which allows him to fight on equal terms with a bear. He dreams of one day being transformed into Shocker, but when faced with reality, he sells off all of his precious Kamen Rider merchandise so that they won't end up as trash if he dies alone. In the midst of this despair, he visits a summer festival where he encounters a robber dressed as Shocker, buys a Kamen Rider No. 1 mask from a stall, calls himself Kamen Rider, and fights evil. A man who is so passionate that he transforms into Kamen Rider for real.

[Mitsuha's](https://anilist.co/character/368777) older brother. A man who fully transforms into Kamen Rider V3. He has no doubt that V3 is the strongest rider, and in order to embody that identity, he has mastered all kinds of martial arts and has high combat abilities. Because "his soul is V3," he does not need to use tools to transform when fighting, and instead faces evil with just his body.

A high school girl who works at [Mitsuha's](https://anilist.co/character/368777) family restaurant. She is in a relationship with Mitsuha, the manager. However, her true identity is that of a female fighter whose mission is to monitor and execute anyone who notices the presence of Shocker. When Mitsuha and her friends notice the presence of Shocker, she attacks Toujima and his friends in an attempt to kill them all in one fell swoop.

A gangster who admires Shocker. Due to the harshness of his childhood, he has doubts about the existence of Kamen Rider, the hero of justice who never saved him, and is devoted to Shocker. During a conflict between gangs, he encounters Spider Man, is pierced through the body, and seems to have lost his life, but when he wakes up, he has become a Shocker fighter.

[Ichiyo's](https://anilist.co/character/368780) younger brother. A man who admires Riderman. He usually works as the manager of a family restaurant and is in a relationship with [Yukarisu](https://anilist.co/character/368778/) an employee. He is such a big fan that he boasts that of all the Kamen Riders, Riderman is his biggest fan, and in battle he uses the attached arms and a fighting style based on Aikido to toy with his enemies.

title: 被姐姐的前未婚夫溺爱的破烂千金

characters.description: Kyros is the only son of the millionaire Duke Granado, and through his own efforts, he achieved the rank of Earl. Although women all over the country have their eyes on him, he dislikes nobles and their social circles, and is tired of marriage proposals. He fell in love with Marie at their first meeting.

Marie is the second daughter of [Baron Shaderan](https://anilist.co/character/369075/Shaderan-Gregor). She was shunned by her parents and forced to live like a servant wearing rags. She's a curious person, but doesn't have confidence in herself.

Head maid of Kyros's household. She is polite and very no-nonsense, but looks after Marie with kindness; seeing she has such poor self-esteem that she has to constant direct her into not overreacting. Mio often investigates or goes undercover to find information for Kyros, leading to her leaving the estate to learn more about Marie's background.

characters.native: リュー・リュー・グラナド
characters.description: Duchess of Granado and Kyros' mother. She is a friendly woman from Ipsandros.

characters.native: アナスタジア・シャデラン
characters.description: Anastasia is the eldest daughter of Baron Shaderan. She is bright and sociable, with a princess-like glamour. In contrast to her younger sister Marie, she is loved by her parents and is expected to marry into a good family, but she actually wants to become a clothing maker in the royal capital.

Fuji is a novelist and a woman who lives at her own pace. One day while enjoying the rain she found [Kimi](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) in a cardboard box, and assumes it is a strange dog.

Kimi enjoys living with [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) after she picks them up on a rainy night. They are curious and quick to act, as well as having an ability to understand human language and write notes.

Ren is a friend of [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) from their school days. She has a healing personality, but speaks frankly with Fuji and [Mimi.](https://anilist.co/character/353781/Mimi) She's good at taking action and likes to travel alone.

Mimi is Fuji's close friend from her school days. She seems like a cool beauty, but has the personality of a caring big sister. She's interested in [Kimi](https://anilist.co/character/353785/Kimi) due to her love for animals, but she keeps her distance due to making a mistake upon their first meeting.

characters.native: クラウゼ・エラ・希依
characters.description: Krause Ella is a well-behaved and curious first grade student, and [Fuji's](https://anilist.co/character/353780/Fuji) neighbor. She attends an international school, and is the daughter of a German mother and Japanese father.

title: 时光流逝，饭菜依旧美味

characters.description: A first-year student who was one of the Food Culture Research Club's initial three members. The shortest member of the club, she wrote their initial and revised applications to the student affairs office, assigning Shinon and Kurea with the first and second-in-command positions without consulting them first. She collects sheep-related memorabilia by means of being associated with her nickname "Hitsuji" (ひつじ、羊). She likes consuming energy drinks and playing the ukulele, though does not consider herself to be an active person.

A first-year student who joins the Food Culture Research Club and enables its approval by being their fourth member. Nicknamed "Makocchi" (まこっち) by childhood friend Shinon (and later Tsutsuji), she works night shifts at an inarizushi bar. Her cooking expertise comes from past experience in her childhood, as well as being a regular viewer of Mokotaro's channel. She helps her club stay within its remit by conducting most of the cooking under the club's name.

A first-year student who was one of the Food Culture Research Club's initial three members, later assigned as the deputy leader. She helps out at her mother's family restaurant, the one Mako previously passed by before learning of Kurea's connection to said restaurant. Before Mako joined the Food Culture Research Club, Kurea encouraged a shy Mako to try out her restaurant. Afterwards, as part of the Food Culture Research Club, Kurea helps Mako with most of the cooking under the club's name, while also being the most level-headed and responsible of her group, making key leadership decisions on the club's behalf.

A first-year student who joins the Food Culture Research Club after it was formed. She knows [Tsutsuji](https://anilist.co/character/357903/Higa-Tsutsuji) from high school and is even more shy around strangers, but exhibits a more outgoing personality around people she perceives as friends. She likes puzzles and had originally intended to start a "Puzzle Club" by herself. She keeps a pet chameleon at home called Pochi.

A first-year student who founded the Food Culture Research Club and is later assigned as its president. She knows [Mako](https://anilist.co/character/357900/Kawai-Mako) from her childhood, but views her previous nickname "Oshinko" as an embarrassment. She is outgoing and hyperactive, but mostly forgetful and sometimes careless. She initially formed her club as a means to slack off on campus, though later helps her club pass an initial inspection, and becomes more involved with relevant club activities over time.
Nakamura is a shy boy who falls in love at first sight with one of his classmates.
Kawamura is a classmate of Nakamura and Hirose and a talented artist.
Reiko is the leader of the Occult Horror Research Club.

Homeroom teacher for [Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/133626/Okuto-Nakamura) and [Hirose's](https://anilist.co/character/133627/Aiki-Hirose) class. He is good at caring for his students but also has a sloppy side.
Tamura is the leader of the Drama AV Club.

Nikola is a NPC in King's Seeker Online with the role of a young villager girl. Her village is always destroyed by a dragon in a doomed event, killing the villagers even if the dragon is defeated. However, she mysteriously revives and joins [Haga](https://anilist.co/character/301224/Haga) on his journey.

Haga is a debugger from the company Nerima Tech who was sent to test an upcoming VR game called "King's Seeker Online" using full immersion technology. He has been unable to log out for the past year, however continues his debugging work. He has an earnest personality but the potential presence of bugs often weighs on his mind.
One of [Haga's](https://anilist.co/character/301224/Makoto-Haga) coworkers on the debug team from Nerima Tech.

Debugger from the company Entermation who is trying to live like a resident of the game world. Her equipment includes a set of black armor and a large sword as a part of her swordsman class. When she first met [Haga](https://anilist.co/character/301224/Makoto-Haga) her armor caused a misunderstanding, but upon meeting again they decided to travel together toward the Principality of Sai.

A part-time debugger hired by the company Asobing who cut ties with the other members after seeing their extreme behavior. He was hiding out in an unknown village and wrote manga for a NPC named Ruu, until their home was destroyed suddenly by [Shachou.](https://anilist.co/character/340184/Shachou) After the village was attacked, he joined [Haga](https://anilist.co/character/301224/Makoto-Haga) on his journey.

characters.native: リドル・ローズハート
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm __Dorm:__ 2nd Year Housewarden of Heartslabyul He has a strict personality and prioritizes rules and regulations above all else. He is feared for meting out the merciless punishment known as "Off with Your Head!" to anyone who violates his dormitory's rules, yet—contrary to the impression this gives—he is actually quite expressive. Although he is a strict individual, his actions are motivated by a desire to improve the dormitory; he is not a bad person at heart, and his usual demeanor is calm (in fact, not a single student has dropped out since he became dorm leader). While he usually leads Heartslabyul with a firm and dignified attitude, he often finds himself being swept up by the antics of those around him. He has a low tolerance for provocation and a quick temper; when angry, his face turns bright red and he lets out a strange, high-pitched shriek of "Ugh-iiiii!!" He is childhood friends with [Trey](https://anilist.co/character/195309/Trey-Clover), who belongs to the same dormitory. He also has a childhood friend, [Chenya](https://anilist.co/character/199056/Alchemi-Alchemivich-Pinka), who attends the rival school, Royal Sword Academy.

__Height:__ 172 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Heartslabyul. He has a fearless personality, speaking his mind openly and cheerfully—sometimes even disrupting the atmosphere of a situation. While his outward demeanor is casual, he is actually a pragmatist who views things realistically; in the story, he often counters others' arguments with sound, logical reasoning. His dislike for indecisiveness likely stems from his own nature of making quick, firm decisions. He is shrewd—for better or worse—and often arrives at conclusions or insights ahead of his fellow dorm mate, [Deuce](https://anilist.co/character/195304/Spade-Deuce). He is quick-witted and articulate enough to hold long conversations even with older people he has just met. He is dexterous and handles tasks competently, but his lack of enthusiasm often leads him to do things half-heartedly; he tends to take the easy way out and can be sloppy when it comes to the final details. Furthermore, whenever he tries to exploit his own cleverness for the wrong reasons, he almost invariably faces some form of comeuppance. Due to his pragmatic mindset and lack of passion, he makes quick judgments—a trait that cuts both ways. In a positive light, he can view situations objectively and take appropriate action; in a negative light, he avoids risk and effort to such an extent that he shies away from challenges that would push his limits, gives up easily, and can be seen as timid. He has no particular dream for the future and tends to look down on getting fired up or earnestly dedicating oneself to something, though he apparently still harbors a desire to defeat the dorm leader.

__Height:__ 173 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Heartslabyul He enrolled in the academy with the intention of becoming a fine mage and leading a serious student life... or so he thought. Shortly after enrolling, however, he was dragged into a squabble between [Ace](https://anilist.co/character/195302/Ace-Trappola) and [Grim](https://anilist.co/character/195303/Grim); consequently, he found himself scrambling alongside the others to avoid expulsion. As fellow first-years, they often stick together within the academy grounds. He is surprised to find that, despite the school's prestigious reputation, it is home to quite a few troublemakers. ~!He went through a rebellious phase in the past, and traces of that time sometimes resurface when his emotions run high. He attributes this past behavior to a time when he was clumsy and saw no results from their efforts, leading him to give up and take the easy way out. His past antics included addressing teachers without honorifics, hanging out with a bad crowd, bleaching his hair, and tearing up mountain passes on a Magical Wheel—behavior that Grim described as being "a textbook delinquent the likes of which you rarely see these days." He considers this a dark chapter of his life he would rather keep hidden. The reason he turned over a new leaf and resolved to change his ways was witnessing his mother tearfully consulting his grandmother over the phone. He is devoted to his mother and used to help out with household chores, such as cooking and carrying groceries.!~

__Height:__ 70 cm __Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Ramshackle Dorm The protagonist's magical beast partner. He is a loudmouth and a bit of a show-off. He calls the protagonist his "henchman" and styles himself the "boss" (though everyone around them treats the protagonist as Grim's guardian). He is recognized as a student only by being paired with the protagonist, who cannot use magic at all. He claims to be a genius and declares he will become a great mage someday, yet he dislikes tedious effort and loathes mundane lessons. Perhaps because of this, he struggles with academic classes and frequently sneaks out of them. As a magical beast, he lacks basic knowledge of human society, often taking on the role of asking questions on the protagonist's behalf. Likely due to his aversion to hard work, his grades are poor; he is quick to spot "cheat sheets" created by Azul and has no qualms about taking the easy route to get good marks.

__Dorm:__ 1st Year Student of Ramshackle Dorm Not much is known about him. He rescued the kendo club in his high school, which was on the verge of disbanding, by recruiting five more people to join it. He's responsible, caring, and determine young man. He has a habit of helping and saving people even though he just met them. He is willing to help his fellow kendo club member's training for the upcoming kendo tournament. He isn't shown to be afraid of ghosts, but instead to be amazing that he can see ghosts without having any magic powers. Yuuken is good at persuading people when he tries to make Ace and Deuce to get together against the Overblot miner even though they don’t get along very well.

Anne is a very talkative little girl, who is always talking to everyone and she even likes to talk alone. She likes to give "poetic" names to things she likes, and has a huge imagination. Anne is a real tomboy and deeply dislikes her red hair. Very warm hearted, she's a loyal friend and daughter, captivating everyone around her with her originality. Anne Shirley is a girl raised in an orphanage who is accidentally sent to [Miss Marilla Cuthbert](https://anilist.co/character/37178/Cuthbert-Marilla) and [Mr. Matthew Cuthbert](https://anilist.co/character/37146/Cuthbert-Matthew), who had originally requested a boy. At first unwanted, she gradually becomes an irreplaceable member of their family.

characters.native: マシュウ・カスバート
characters.description: Marilla's brother, a shy, awkward man who takes a liking to Anne from the start. The two become fast friends. He is far less talkative than Anne, but is a very good listener. He also sometimes lets Anne have things which Marilla considers too frivolous, such as a dress with puffed sleeves.

A crisp, practical, no-nonsense woman who completely disapproves of Anne's wild imagination, although she does grow to love the orphan. Her sense of humour develops greatly upon Anne's arrival, and Mrs. Lynde states that she became "mellow".

Anne's dearest friend and kindred spirit. Anne and Diana become best friends from the moment they meet. She is the only girl of Anne's age who lives close to Green Gables. While Anne does not think Diana is very imaginative, Diana is noted for being pretty, merry and very amiable. She is often puzzled by Anne's extreme imagination, but she does have a little imagination of her own.

characters.native: ギルバート・ブライス
characters.description: Gilbert first tried to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots". Anne hit him over the head with her slate and refused to have anything to do with him. Even though Gilbert apologizes shortly after the incident, Anne remains scornful toward him for a few years, but Gilbert never abandons his quest for her friendship. Anne forgives Gilbert by the end of the book and the two become friends - and eventually marry in a later book in the series, "Anne's House of Dreams". (Gilbert's father was Marilla's girlhood sweetheart. Marilla seems to find a special satisfaction in the fact that Anne and Gilbert finally become friends.)

characters.native: ベイルヘイラ・ラングダス
characters.description: Belle is the current administrator of Antomulrag's dungeon.

Previously member of Antomulrag thieves' guild, she is now working for Antomulrag's dungeon. Clay is searching for [Brance](https://anilist.co/character/319228) (her father) who disappeared 3 years ago in the dungeon.
A dwarf in charge of levels 1 through 4 of Antomulrag's dungeon.
[Clay](https://anilist.co/character/319227)'s father. He disappeared in Antomulrag's dungeon 3 years ago.
[Renfringe](https://anilist.co/character/319232/Renfringe)'s assistant.

A vampire who hides in plain sight at a boys' school, living in the student dorms and working part time at a cafe to blend in. He thinks Mito is a guy. He might look like a hottie, but he's secretly a total nerd.
A boy with a bad reputation who lives in the dorms. He knows Ruka is a vampire and has vowed to protect Mito from him. ~!He is a dhampir, a child of a vampire and a human.!~

Orphaned at a young age and abandoned by her distant relatives, she became smitten by Ruka and agreed to become his thrall- a willing donor of blood. She disguises herself as a boy to avoid unwanted attention. Lives with Ruka in the dorms.
Classmate of Mito and Ruka. He works at the cafe.
Ruka's servant. He can transform into a bat.

When Aoi was seven years old, he wandered into the Momochi House and was chosen as the Omamori-sama. He transforms into Nue to perform his duties, but it seems this role was meant for Himari. When he transforms into Nue, he becomes an ayakashi the ears of a cat, the wings of a bird, and the tail of a fox. As the Omamori-sama, the nue protects Momochi House and eliminates demons who make their way in from the spiritual realm.
A 16-year-old orphan who, according to a certain will, has inherited Momochi House. As rightful owner, she has the ability to expel beings from the house.
One of Omamori-sama's shikigami. He is a water serpent.
One of omamori-sama's shikigami. He is an orangutan.

A childhood friend of Aoi who still has some fragments of his memories with him. He is the descendant of a family that had the power to control the Kuda-gitsune, a fox-like spirit, although he demonstrated that he did not inherit this ability, he still has some connection with the spirit world. (Source: Wikipedia)

Ruriko is a young woman who works as a beer vendor in the ballpark. She tries hard to engage with her customers, unlike her normally shy personality. ~!Later in the story it is implied she has developed a crush on Murata.!~
A 30-year old salaryman who often comes alone to the stadium. Ruriko often flirts with him and he always buys beer from her. ~!He becomes her first regular customer.!~

Natsuno is a college student working part-time as a bento shop cashier at the stadium. She has a crush on Murata, who she calls her "prince". She is distinguished by her long wavy hair, covered on top by a bandana.
Yuki is Kojiro's devoted wife who always comes to the stadium to watch his games and cheer him on.

Kohinata is the most experienced beer vendor working in the stadium. She is an office lady who has also been working part-time at the stadium for 10 years. She is distinguished by her long black hair, mole under her mouth and her sizable bust.

__Height:__ 167 cm __Position:__ Second Base

Mao is the main character of the eponymous story Mao. Throughout his long life, Mao has remained mature, reserved and somewhat aloof. He tends to dwell on his past and what he can't remember, which drives his obsessive search for the Byōki who cursed him. Mao favors onmyōdō exorcism and healing techniques, and avoids curse techniques. When in his Byōki form, Mao is outside the bounds of the Chinese elemental cycle, allowing him to attack at will without the threat of being exorcised.

Nanoka Kiba is the narrator and heroine of the story Mao. Outspoken, determined and brave, Nanoka is extremely curious about the circumstances of her and Mao's curse, leading her to research history with her classmate, Shiraha, when she returns home from the Taisho era. Despite her being a natural fighter, Nanoka is afraid to engage in conflict. She believes herself to be too weak to win against most opponents, but with her excursions with Mao, is growing more confident in her abilities.
Otoya is a kid serving the protagonist Mao. He’s a Shikigami, the result of Mao infusing his spiritual power onto a doll.

Hyakka is a former classmate of [Mao](https://anilist.co/character/138866/Mao) from 900 years ago. He was an apprentice 900 years ago, then worked in a circus, but he now travels with Mao and [Nanoka](https://anilist.co/character/138867/Kiba-Nanoka).

Kamon, also known as Kuchinawa, is a former senior disciple from 900 years ago. Following the Great Kanto Earthquake, he was serving Tanehiko who captured and murdered women in his mansion, by getting rid of their corpses. Just as he reunites with Mao who came to rescue Tanehiko's last victim Tenko, he was hired by his father to kill him as he was removed from power of the mansion due to his murders and does so by making his heart squeeze out. He and Mao then recognize each other and have a conversation about what happened 900 years ago although Kamon didn't know much detail.

Mizuki Ashiya, who is Japanese, but moved to America when she was young, is the heroine of the story. She spontaneously moved from California to Japan and enrolled into an all boys school (Osaka Gakuen) because her idol, Sano Izumi, who’s a top high jumper and the same age as her, attends the school. To look like a boy, she keeps her hair short and ruffled and wears a tight demin vest to hide her boobs. In many ways, it’s good that she has a pretty flat chest, but she wants more cleavage. She’s a very fast runner (due to her mother’s athleticism), but is very clumsy at times (due to her father’s clumsiness). Mizuki loves all kinds of food, especially sweet things, which is a strong contrast to Izumi's dislike of them. Also, she can be quite stingy when it comes to sharing her food. She’s also a lover of animals, as we can see when she’s with Yujirou, Sano’s dog.

He likes Mizuki, but doesn't know that she is really a girl, and some of his classmates believe that he is gay due to that fact. Nakatsu also seems to have come to terms with that fact. As Umeda says,"...he's only attracted to her feminine side," meaning that Nakatsu is responding as any teenage male would to being around a female, although it would appear he is a bit more excitable than his classmates as none of them seem to be affected by Mizuki-- or they simply hide it better. At times, he is very jealous of Sano because of how close he is to Mizuki. He entered the school with a football (soccer) scholarship, and is very good at it. Originally from Osaka (the city, which is different from the school and spelled with different kanji), he has a thick Kansai accent and frequently uses the Kansai dialect.

The guy that Mizuki Ashiya likes and an excellent high jumper. He finds out that Mizuki is a girl early in the series, but does not tell anyone else and actually becomes very protective of her secret. Before Mizuki came to Japan, Sano had been in an accident (he had tried to save his team captain from getting hit by a car, injuring his leg), causing him to quit high jumping for a while because he thought that he couldn't handle the pressure. But thanks to Mizuki's deal with her brother (Sano had to jump while her brother was in Japan, or Mizuki would have to come home), he is able to try again and was given a second chance to high jump. Sano falls in love with Mizuki, but cannot tell her because Mizuki thinks that if Sano found out her secret, she would have to leave.

The R.A. of Sano and Mizuki's dorm. He's a nephew of Umeda-sensei, and is one school-year older than Mizuki. He's a "ladies man" although very sensible. He was once in love with his tutor, Kanako Tanabe, but she left him. Umeda claims that this was what caused Nanba to become the "ladies man" he is today. In the future, it is said that he became a model. He, along with the other R.A.s finds out that Mizuki is a girl, but helps keep her secret (although it wasn't a secret for very long). Among Mizuki's group of friends, he seems to frequently butt heads with Nakatsu. He's also a former winner of the Miss Osaka pageant, during his first year at Osaka, a fact which he isn't terribly proud of. source: wikipedia

Taiki is Nakatsu's roommate, and has the ability to see ghosts and detect auras. He is always doing Nakatsu's aura report. He's also into yoga. When he first comes to Osaka High, he was teased by others due to his ESP skills. However, Nakatsu sees him as a good friend. In volume 4, Nakajo noted that Kayashima took his name from the "Kayashima Station", a railway station on the Keihan Main Line. He also claimed that many workers were injured during the construction of the station, as a large tree was considered to be cut down. The tree was later preserved, and the station was built around it. Incidentally, "Taiki" means "large tree". (Source: Wikipedia)
An honor student who is cool in both speech and attitude, he is the student council president of Aogasaki High School. While he is cool, he also has a kind side, as he helps Mizuho with her studies.

A competitive swimmer on the Aogasaki High School swim team, Kizuki is seen as the "baby" of the group, due to his careless nature. Regardless, he wants to be seen as a "man" and not as Mizuho's little brother.

A second-year high school student aspiring to become a manga artist. She has four childhood friends she's known for the past ten years. She longs for the sparkling youth, but has no experience in love. In ten years she'll become an editor for a shoujo manga.
Mizuki's childhood friend who had a rebellious phase in middle school, while coming to terms with his sexuality. Ten years in the future, he becomes a model.
A boy who enjoys literature. He is the most harsh of the four, but he is also the mood maker. He is always teasing Mizuho. He inherited his love of cooking from his father.
__Height:__ 188 cm The titular human teacher at Hyakki Academy, a youkai school. He teaches Japanese, and is the homeroom teacher of Class 2-3.
__Height:__ 175 cm A student in Class 2-3 at Hyakki Academy. He is a yakubyougami.
__Height:__ 135 cm A student in Class 2-3 at Hyakki Academy. He is a mamedanuki.
__Height:__ 171 cm A shuten-douji oni. He teaches Youkai Studies at Hyakki Academy.
A student at Hyakki Academy and member of Abe Haruaki's class. He is a nekomata youkai, which is part of the youkai group that can transform into animals.

A cool-headed girl with clear eyes who has taken refuge at Outsuki Detective Agency. She constantly accompanies [Sakuya](https://anilist.co/character/379913/Sakuya-Outsuki) as his assistant, supporting him with her sharp intellect and exceptional physical abilities.

A half-baked high school detective. Son of a legendary master detective. Possesses a special constitution that allows him to come back to life even after being killed. Writing his will daily is his routine, just in case he dies at any moment.

characters.native: シャルディナ・ インフェリシャス
characters.description: One of the "Seven Old Men." As a celebrity thief, she makes extravagant appearances and displays her extraordinary wealth with flamboyant flair.
A rising actress with a lively and curious personality. She becomes [Sakuya's](https://anilist.co/character/379913/Sakuya-Outsuki) apprentice to prepare for her role as a detective.
Part of a famous detective duo from Britain. As their assistant, Belka translates [Fido's](https://anilist.co/character/389411/Fido) words into human speech.
Heli is a vampire in the twelfth grade at Decelis Academy and the captain and center of the Nightball Team.
He is a vampire-werewolf hybrid in the tenth grade at Decelis Academy and a forward of the Nightball Team.
He is a vampire at Decelis Academy and the wing of the Nightball Team.
Shion is a vampire in the tenth grade at Decelis Academy and a back of the Nightball Team.
He is a vampire in the eleventh grade at Decelis Academy and a back of the Nightball Team.

Su-Ha is honest and expressive with her feelings. She hates vampires because of her superhuman strength she was constantly mistaken to be one, in consequence she repeatedly had to move to different cities. Also a vampire killed her only friend Chris.
He is a vampire in the twelfth grade at Decelis Academy and the enforcer of the Nightball Team.
He is a vampire at Decelis Academy and a forward of the Nightball Team.

title: 邻国王子的溺爱反派千金

characters.native: ティアラローズ･ラピス･クラメンティール
characters.description: The villainess of the game The Lapis Lazuli Ring and the daughter of a marquis. She is originally engaged to Prince Hartknights, who breaks off his engagement with her to be with Akari. She is a reincarnated former player of the game who died before she could play the sequel starring Aquasteed. She likes baking and sweets.

characters.native: アクアスティード･マリンフォレスト
characters.description: The main love interest of the sequel of the otome game The Lapis Lazuli Ring. He is the prince of the kingdom of Marineforest and fell in love with Tiararose while studying abroad in the Lapis-Lazuli kingdom.

The heroine of the otome game The Ring of Lapis Lazuli. She was also a former player who reincarnated into the game. While she likes the character of Hartknights, she likes Aquasteed even better. She has the sought after power of the Holy Prayer. She has an air of angelic cuteness, but she's very thoughtless and selfish, making it doubtful that she would make a good future queen.

characters.native: ハルトナイツ･ラピスラズリ･ラクトムート
characters.description: The main love interest of the game The Lapis Lazuli Ring. He is the crown prince of the Lapis Lazuli kingdom. He was originally engaged to Tiararose.
The king of the forest fairies of the Marineforest Kingdom. He is very selfish and arrogant, putting his own desires before anyone else's. He has feelings for Tiararose and wants to make her his own.
